one_liner: Work management platform combining spreadsheet-style sheets with project/workflow automation.

auth.evidence_quote: If your scenario involves user consent and interaction, it's typically best to use OAuth with Smartsheet. Note that the Smartsheet implementation of OAuth 2.0 is a 3-legged process, which requires human intervention.
auth.notes: Direct API access tokens (bearer, generated in the UI) are also supported for single-account/machine-to-machine use.

access.evidence_quote: Each API request requires passing in an access token as the Bearer value in your authorization header.
access.notes: Smartsheet is generally a paid product with a free trial rather than a permanent free tier; no explicit app-review/marketplace gate found within budget.

api.evidence_quote: the Smartsheet implementation of OAuth 2.0 is a 3-legged process, which requires human intervention
api.notes: MCP availability not checked within budget.

verdict.rationale: OAuth2 and token-based REST API are documented, but Smartsheet does not appear to offer a permanent free tier, only a trial.
